# GasMeUp

> GasMeUp scans live gas prices around you and ranks every station by what the fill-up really costs, including the drive to get there. iPhone and Android, US only.

- Launched: August 2026 (Android August 2, iPhone August 6)
- Founder: Vaughn Fisher, solo developer, San José, California
- Pricing: $1.99 a month, or $17.99 a year with a 7-day free trial on the annual plan. No ads, no sponsored stations, no selling of user data.
- How it works: one tap scans live prices at every station around you, the app counts the drive into every price, and the Best Pick is the fill-up that costs least in total. Highway Mode scans the road ahead on long drives and shows the best stop exit by exit.
